part_updates.name: GE whole home pleated sediment filter (FXWPC)
part_updates.notes: OEM pleated sediment cartridge (~30 µm sand/sediment reduction); GE service 3 months or 16000 gallons. Not carbon — FXWTC is the carbon-paper SKU in this family.

model_notes_updates.notes: In-box sediment: FXUSC (Rev. 2). GE pleated sediment alternate: FXWPC. Carbon/chlorine in this family: FXWTC — not FXWPC. Confirm stamped cartridge on your head.

explicit_exclusions: No ge-fxhtc interval or copy changes
